title: Endless Bloom
statement:
Endless Bloom unfolds as a continuous field of shifting color and motion. Soft waves of luminous pigment expand, dissolve, and reform in a steady rhythm, creating an atmosphere of suspended transformation.

The work originates from a custom generative system built in TouchDesigner, where motion and color evolve through real-time computational processes. In its extended studio configuration, licensed audio is integrated through TouchDesigner’s audio analysis workflow, allowing sound frequency and amplitude to influence visual behavior.
